# Training Magazine

> > Training Magazine: A 50+ year resource for learning and development professionals covering workplace training, leadership development, AI-powered learning, and professional development strategies.

Training Magazine serves L&D professionals with industry insights, best practices, and resources. The publication hosts the Training Conference & Expo, TechLearn Conference, Training MVP Awards, and Emerging Training Leaders programs, while covering topics from AI tutors and executive coaching to skilled-trade training and front-line management.

## Key Topics

- Learning & Development (L&D)
- Professional Development
- Leadership Development
- AI-Powered Learning & ChatGPT
- Workplace Training
- Training Conference & Expo
- TechLearn Conference
- Training MVP Awards
- Emerging Training Leaders
- Executive Coaching
- Skilled-Trade Training
- Front-Line Management
- Personalized Learning
- Learning in Flow of Work
- Training Magazine Network Choice Awards
